test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

I can’t believe that you’re ________ (resolute) enough to not even decide what you want for dinner.
solution: The correct answer is: **Indecisive** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Resolute **means having a firm determination or being unwavering in purpose. (दृढ़ निश्चय होना या उद्देश्य में अटल होना) • **Example**: *Despite facing numerous challenges, he remained resolute in achieving his goals.* • Therefore, the opposite would be someone unsure or unable to make a decision. • Marked option **Indecisive **means unable to make decisions, hesitant, and lacking firmness. (निर्णय लेने में असमर्थ, झिझकने वाला तथा दृढ़ता का अभाव) • **Example**: *Sarah was indecisive about which college to attend.* Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Reluctant** means unwilling or hesitant to do something. (कुछ करने में अनिच्छा या झिझक) • **Disinclined **means unwilling or lacking enthusiasm for something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति अनिच्छा या उत्साह की कमी) • **Gullible **means easily fooled or deceived. (आसानी से मूर्ख बनाया या धोखा दिया जा सकता है) 3f:T6d0, The correct answer is: **ADCB**
